FFmpeg separate executable · source offer

Nabbit distributes an unmodified FFmpeg executable from BtbN's FFmpeg Static
Auto-Builds project, now hosted as FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds. The executable
is licensed under GNU GPL version 3 or later. It is invoked as a separate
process. No libav library is linked into Nabbit. Only ffmpeg.exe is bundled;
ffprobe, ffplay, DLLs, nonfree builds and HEVC Store codecs are not bundled.

The Nabbit contributors offer the complete corresponding machine-readable
source code for the distributed FFmpeg executable, including the applicable
dependency sources and scripts needed to build it, at no charge for electronic
delivery. This offer is valid for at least three years after the last
distribution of the corresponding executable. Anyone who possesses a copy
of that executable may request the source through:
https://github.com/tanzir71/nabbit/issues
Include the executable's SHA-256 and platform from this screen in the request.
This source offer is in addition to the upstream source locations below.

Pinned upstream release (both x64 and ARM64):
https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/tag/autobuild-2026-11-27-12-42
Build scripts, dependency recipes and patches at the release commit:
https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/tree/d05871a37b5fc80e00714c708edec35c7b9ebfb0
Build scripts archive:
https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/archive/d05871a37b5fc80e00714c708edec35c7b9ebfb0.tar.gz
FFmpeg source revision: 7fdb4c2341
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/7fdb4c2341

The exact configure lines and SHA-256 values for each original executable
appear below. Build instructions use the pinned scripts with target win64
or winarm64 and variant gpl. See scripts.d for dependency recipes and patches.
The original GPL text accompanies this offer. FFmpeg and its dependencies
remain copyright their respective contributors. There is no warranty; see
the included licence terms.
